questions.prompt: Jack's mother wondered________. A) how much he cost the computer B) how much he paid for the computer C) how much the computer will cost him D) how much did he spend on the computer

options.A: how much he cost the computer
options.B: how much he paid for the computer
options.C: how much the computer will cost him
options.D: how much did he spend on the computer

questions.topicReason: 考查宾语从句的陈述语序及相关表达，正确为 how much he paid for the computer。
